title: lazyswap
tagline: LazySwap envisions a future where cross-chain cryptocurrency swaps are as effortless as a single message.
description: LazySwap envisions a future where cross-chain cryptocurrency swaps are as effortless as a single message. By leveraging advanced AI and Chainflip’s powerful technology, LazySwap simplifies the swapping process to just a few lines of chat. The name "LazySwap" reflects our commitment to making cross-chain swaps as easy and convenient as possible—no complex menus or multiple steps required. With LazySwap, you simply tell the bot what you want to swap, and our AI handles the rest. This seamless, conversational approach ensures that users can perform swaps quickly and effortlessly, redefining simplicity and efficiency in the world of crypto trading.
how_its_made:
LangGraph.js: Used to define, coordinate, and execute multiple LLM agents.

AI Models: Utilized ChatGroq and ChatCloudflareWorkersAI for natural language processing.

🔗 Chainflip SDK Integration

How It's Used:

Cross-Chain Swaps: The Chainflip SDK is used to facilitate cross-chain cryptocurrency swaps, enabling users to transfer assets between different blockchains.

Validation: The SDK is used to validate chains and tokens against the supported list, ensuring that only valid swaps are processed.

Quote Generation: The SDK is used to generate quotes for the swap, providing users with the expected deposit and receive amounts.

Deposit Address Generation: The SDK is used to request a deposit address for the user to send their funds.
